def __init__(self, num_channels: int, num_channels_reduced: Optional[int]=
    None, reduction_ratio: float=2.0, is_3d: bool=False, activation:
    Optional[nn.Module]=None) ->None:
    super().__init__()

    if num_channels_reduced is None:
        num_channels_reduced = int(num_channels // reduction_ratio)
